title: D4 (operator 2026-11-18): remove the NEED for a gross-exposure cap on IB. MEASURED 2026-11-18 22:35Z ib_paper venue = journal: MGC short 27 (~1.02M notional at ~3770 x 10), TLT long 5536 (~0.44M), GLD short 382 (~0.14M) => ~1.6M gross, ~1.5x the ~1.03M equity on file (PI-20261104-KKPOFDJQ-0004), MGC alone ~1x. ROOT CAUSE (replayed 2026-10-24, docs/research/mgc-sizing-oversize-2026-10-24.md; re-confirmed on trade 7737: stop 12.6 pt = 0.33% of price): the sizer is arithmetically right; flat 1.5% risk over a 0.26-0.40% stop gives 3.7-5.8x notional per futures trade. The 1.5x cap then BRICKS the account (headroom <= 0 refuses every new trade: 6892-6895 'sized_qty=0'), and exposure is read from the JOURNAL, so a stale open row bricks it further. Stacking/over-cover paths (#26862; PI-20261117-LSFHBH4A-0006) multiply it. PROPOSED FIX (Tier 3, Stage-0 test first): size on max(declared stop distance, k x ATR(14)) so a tight stop cannot buy leverage (stop unchanged); then measure whether 1.5x ever binds on the ib_paper corpus and, if not, propose retiring both IB caps. Also read exposure from the VENUE, not the journal. Next: author the Stage-0 unit. Gates this adds: none.
